_comment: Card values and native card data. Position modifiers must be real fcc_trainingcards definitions: synthetic ids render as broken cards.
_quickSellComment: baseCompetitionRareflags are the ordinary cards of a competition (UCL base 47/48, CONMEBOL Sudamericana 52 and Libertadores 53): they carry their own shells but are not promos, so they sell like rares.
_rarityGroupComment: SBC 'Min. X Rare' rules are PLAYER_RARITY_GROUP checks (item.groups includes the id), so every card with rareflag >= 1 carries this group.
_statSlotsComment: Players carry this many {index, value} statsList/lifetimeStats rows; Player Stats > Top Players indexes them directly.
_conceptComment: Concept players are never owned. Their item ids are conceptItemIdBase + resource id, below conceptItemIdBase + conceptItemIdSpan.
_managersComment: Manager definitions without their own values: default rating, and the rating from which one is rare.
_playerPickComment: The 1-of-N player pick token. {choices} and {rating} are replaced by the token's choice count and minimum rating.

playerPickToken.name: 1 of {choices} {rating}+ Player Pick
playerPickToken.description: Choose one of {choices} players rated {rating} or higher.

_consumablesComment: Native development (position change) and training (chemistry style) consumable stacks. starterStack is how many of each definition a club is given once.
_legacyModifiersComment: Early local builds created synthetic position cards in this resource id range; they are replaced by native definitions.
_chemistryStylesComment: A chemistry style card's cardsubtypeid is the playStyle it gives a player. Resource ids follow the fcc_trainingcards position-change rows: firstResourceId + (playStyle - 250). Goalkeeper styles apply only to goalkeepers; cards never given a style play as the default.
_consumableCountersComment: Club > Consumables counters: the counter each native card asset id adds to, and for records without one, the counter of their consumableType. teamFitnessSubType splits team from player fitness.
_aquaProComment: Custom pro-player shells use their own definition ids, but some screens still consult the base gold card; both receive the same maxed attributes. They are never offered as player-pick choices.
_attributesComment: The six face stats and the attributes each one summarises. CardsDLL reserves 34 in-game slots: the 29 outfield attributes in group order, then five goalkeeper values (GK speed is derived by the game).
